title: Director of Peptide Chemistry and Formulation

cond_0001.intro: We are looking for a Director of Peptide Chemistry and Formulation to join our team.
cond_0001.responsibilities: Responsible for peptide synthesis, purification, lyophilization, conjugation. Provide direction in therapeutic peptide drug development, target identification to candidate selection of peptide drugs, as well as contribute to research activities in support of CTA/IND submissions. Provide direction and strategy in formulation development of current company on going anti diabetes and anticancer drugs. Lead a team to develop a long-acting peptide drug. Help to establish R&D scale and manufacturing scale in peptide drug development. Closely interact with analytical department and non-clinical department to assist the drug characterization and MOA. Partnering with other preclinical functional groups, with program management, and other internal functions, as well as external collaborators and consultants, to achieve research milestones culminating in successful IND-filings. Effective internal and external scientific communications (e.g. Reports, regulatory documents, research publications).
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Ph.D. In Peptide chemistry and formulation
At least 10 years experience in peptide drug research and drug formulation, and protein conjugation
Experience operating and maintaining peptide synthesizers
Experience with purification of synthesis peptides, conjugation, and lyophilization
Preferred Requirements
Experience with conjugation of therapeutic peptide with recombinant human albumin
Experience supervising and directing a formulation team to develop a long-acting peptide drug and oral peptide drug
cond_0001.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

cond_0276.intro:
We are looking for a Director of Peptide Chemistry and Formulation to join our team. [Company name masked] creates novel, next-generation medicines using unique, long-acting therapeutic peptides. Underlying all [Company name masked] compounds are bioconjugation platforms called [Product name masked] and [Product name masked]. When applied to a given peptide, [Product name masked] and [Product name masked] can create new drugs with similar therapeutic activities but with significantly longer durations of activity and improved safety profiles.
The Director of Peptide Chemistry and Formulation will be responsible for leading new peptide drug development and new formulation for the peptide drugs.
cond_0276.responsibilities:
Lead peptide synthesis, purification, lyophilization, and conjugation, staying in regular contact with the analytical and non-clinical departments to support drug characterization and MOA.

Provide direction and strategy in formulation development of current ongoing anti-diabetes and anticancer drugs.
Lead a team day-to-day to develop a long-acting peptide drug.
Help establish R&D scale and manufacturing scale in peptide drug development.
Work closely and regularly with preclinical functional groups, program management, other internal functions, and external collaborators and consultants to reach research milestones and successful IND filings.
Communicate scientific findings clearly and proactively, both internally and externally, through reports, regulatory documents, and research publications.

Ph.D. In Peptide Chemistry and Formulation
At least 10 years of experience in peptide drug research and drug formulation, including protein conjugation
Experience operating and maintaining peptide synthesizers
Experience with purification of synthesized peptides, conjugation, and lyophilization
Experience supervising and directing a formulation team to develop a long-acting peptide drug and oral peptide drug
Preferred Requirements
Experience with conjugation of therapeutic peptides with recombinant human albumin

cond_0303.intro:
We are looking for a Director of Peptide Chemistry and Formulation to join our team. [Company name masked] creates novel, next-generation medicines using unique, long-acting therapeutic peptides. Underlying all [Company name masked] compounds are bioconjugation platforms called [Product name masked] and [Product name masked]. When applied to a given peptide, [Product name masked] and [Product name masked] can create new drugs with similar therapeutic activities but with significantly longer durations of activity and improved safety profiles.
The Director of Peptide Chemistry and Formulation will be responsible for leading new peptide drug development and new formulation for the peptide drugs.
cond_0303.responsibilities: Lead peptide synthesis, purification, lyophilization, and conjugation, staying in regular contact with team members throughout each stage. Actively contribute direction in therapeutic peptide drug development, from target identification to candidate selection, and contribute to research activities in support of CTA/IND submissions. Provide direction and strategy in formulation development of current ongoing anti-diabetes and anticancer drugs, communicating progress and trade-offs clearly to relevant groups. Partner with other preclinical functional groups, program management, and other internal functions, as well as external collaborators and consultants, initiating discussions as needed to achieve research milestones culminating in successful IND filings. Handle internal and external scientific communications (e.g. Reports, regulatory documents, research publications), including walking stakeholders through findings and addressing questions.

At least 10 years working experience in peptide research and drug formulation, and protein conjugation. Experience operating and maintaining peptide synthesizers. Experience with conjugation of therapeutic peptide with recombinant human albumin. Experience with purification of synthesis peptides, conjugation, and lyophilization. Experience supervising and directing a formulation team to develop a long-acting peptide drug and oral peptide drug.

cond_0362.intro: We are looking for a Director of Peptide Chemistry and Formulation to join our team.
cond_0362.responsibilities: Responsible for peptide synthesis, purification, lyophilization, conjugation. Provide direction in therapeutic peptide drug development, target identification to candidate selection of peptide drugs, as well as contribute to research activities in support of CTA/IND submissions. Provide direction and strategy in formulation development of current company on going anti diabetes and anticancer drugs. Lead a team to develop a long-acting peptide drug. Help to establish R&D scale and manufacturing scale in peptide drug development. Closely interact with analytical department and non-clinical department to assist the drug characterization and MOA. Partnering with other preclinical functional groups, with program management, and other internal functions, as well as external collaborators and consultants, to achieve research milestones culminating in successful IND-filings. Effective internal and external scientific communications (e.g. Reports, regulatory documents, research publications).
cond_0362.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Ph.D. In Peptide Chemistry and Formulation; advanced degree strongly preferred.
Minimum 10 years of demonstrated expertise in peptide drug research and drug formulation.
Proven track record in protein conjugation, with deep knowledge of conjugation of therapeutic peptides with recombinant human albumin.
Strong command of peptide synthesizer operation and maintenance.
Extensive expertise in purification of synthesized peptides, conjugation, and lyophilization.
Preferred Requirements
Substantial experience supervising and directing a formulation team to develop long-acting peptide drugs and oral peptide drugs.

cond_0477.intro:
We are looking for a Director of Peptide Chemistry and Formulation to join our team. [Company name masked] creates novel, next-generation medicines using unique, long-acting therapeutic peptides. Underlying all [Company name masked] compounds are bioconjugation platforms called [Product name masked] and [Product name masked]. When applied to a given peptide, [Product name masked] and [Product name masked] can create new drugs with similar therapeutic activities but with significantly longer durations of activity and improved safety profiles.
The Director of Peptide Chemistry and Formulation will work with the team to support new peptide drug development and new formulation for the peptide drugs.
cond_0477.responsibilities:
Coordinate peptide synthesis, purification, lyophilization, and conjugation with relevant team members.
Share direction in therapeutic peptide drug development, from target identification to candidate selection, and contribute to research activities in support of CTA/IND submissions.
Work alongside colleagues to provide direction and strategy in formulation development of current ongoing anti-diabetes and anticancer drugs.
Collaborate with a team to develop a long-acting peptide drug.
Help establish R&D scale and manufacturing scale in peptide drug development.
Work closely with the analytical and non-clinical departments to support drug characterization and MOA.
Partner with other preclinical functional groups, program management, and other internal functions, as well as external collaborators and consultants, to reach research milestones and support successful IND filings.
Support internal and external scientific communications, including reports, regulatory documents, and research publications.
cond_0477.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Ph.D. In Peptide Chemistry and Formulation.
At least 10 years of experience in peptide drug research and drug formulation, including protein conjugation.
Experience operating and maintaining peptide synthesizers.
Experience with purification of synthesized peptides, conjugation, and lyophilization.
Preferred Requirements
Experience with conjugation of therapeutic peptides with recombinant human albumin.
Experience supervising and directing a formulation team to develop a long-acting peptide drug and oral peptide drug.

cond_0645.intro:
We are looking for a Director of Peptide Chemistry and Formulation to join our team. [Company name masked] creates novel, next-generation medicines using unique, long-acting therapeutic peptides. Underlying all [Company name masked] compounds are bioconjugation platforms called [Product name masked] and [Product name masked]. When applied to a given peptide, [Product name masked] and [Product name masked] can create new drugs with similar therapeutic activities but with significantly longer durations of activity and improved safety profiles.
The Director of Peptide Chemistry and Formulation will be responsible for leading new peptide drug development and new formulation for the peptide drugs.
cond_0645.responsibilities: Lead peptide synthesis, purification, lyophilization, and conjugation, staying in regular contact with team members throughout each stage. Actively contribute direction in therapeutic peptide drug development, from target identification to candidate selection, and contribute to research activities in support of CTA/IND submissions. Provide direction and strategy in formulation development of current ongoing anti-diabetes and anticancer drugs, communicating progress and trade-offs clearly to relevant groups. Lead a team on a daily basis to develop a long-acting peptide drug. Help establish R&D scale and manufacturing scale in peptide drug development. Work closely with the analytical and non-clinical departments, regularly connecting with colleagues to assist with drug characterization and MOA. Partner with other preclinical functional groups, program management, and other internal functions, as well as external collaborators and consultants, initiating discussions as needed to achieve research milestones culminating in successful IND filings. Handle internal and external scientific communications (e.g. Reports, regulatory documents, research publications), including walking stakeholders through findings and addressing questions.
